methods.title: Category 11: products that use electricity or fuel directly, over their expected lifetime (eGRID2023 rev2; Hub 2025 Table 1)
methods.formula: lifetime energy = units sold x lifetime (years or uses) x energy per year or use; electricity: MWh (kWh x 0.001) x eGRID2023 rev2 output emission rate of the region of use (subregion SRL23, or U.S. US23) x 0.45359237 per gas; fuel: as fuels sold (Hub Table 1); kg CO2e = CO2 + CH4 x 28 + N2O x 265 (calculation guidance formula 11.1)

methods.title: Category 11: fuels sold, combusted by their users (Hub 2025 Table 1; biogenic CO2 of biomass fuels reported separately)
methods.formula: MMBtu = quantity x Hub Table 1 default heat content (or MMBtu as stated); kg CO2 = MMBtu x kg CO2 per MMBtu (biomass fuels: biogenic CO2, reported separately and never in the total); kg CH4 and N2O = MMBtu x g per MMBtu x 0.001; kg CO2e = CO2 + CH4 x 28 + N2O x 265; a feedstock not combusted in use is a known zero (calculation guidance formula 11.2)

methods.title: Category 11: products that contain greenhouse gases released during use (Hub 2025 Tables 11 and 12, AR5)
methods.formula: kg gas released = units sold x charge per unit (kg, or lb x 0.45359237) x use-phase release percent / 100; kg CO2e = kg released x AR5 100-year GWP (Hub Table 11, or Table 12 for a blend) (calculation guidance formula 11.3); memo (outside totals, an upper bound): the charge left at end of life = units sold x charge per unit x (100 - use-phase release percent) / 100 x the same GWP

methods.title: Category 12: end of life of sold products and their packaging, by treatment split (Hub Table 9)
methods.formula: short tons = mass as for waste (lb / 2000, kg / (0.45359237 x 2000) or metric tons x 1000 / (0.45359237 x 2000), rounded half-even to 12 dp); per treatment: short tons x share / 100 x factor (metric tons CO2e per short ton) x 1000; kg CO2e = sum over the treatments (calculation guidance formula 12.1)

methods.title: Category 15: investments and project finance, investee- or project-reported scope 1 and 2 x the investment-specific attribution share
methods.formula: attribution share = outstanding amount / denominator (EVIC, total equity plus debt, or total project cost; rounded half-even to 12 dp), or equity share percent / 100; kg CO2e = reported scope 1 and 2 (metric tons CO2e x 1000) x share (calculation guidance formulas 15.1 and 15.3); projected lifetime emissions of a project (annual x years x share) are a memo item, reported separately and never in the total

methods.title: Category 15: investments, investee revenue x EPA Supply Chain GHG Emission Factors v1.3 without margins x attribution share (an upper-bound proxy)
methods.formula: kg CO2e = investee revenue (USD) x factor without margins (kg CO2e per 2022 USD, NAICS-6 of the investee) x r x attribution share; r = I2022 / I(revenue year) of the BEA GDP implicit price deflator, rounded half-even to 12 dp (none for 2022 dollars); share as for reported investments (calculation guidance formula 15.2)

Assumption or limitation: Products containing greenhouse gases count only the share of the gas released during use, as the company states with its basis; release at end of life belongs in category 12.
